description: Train direct physical IQ mixture on all legal source fit IDs excluding prior IDs, emphasizing parent misclassifications, with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2, source-only training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six blind physical posterior waveforms and F candidate features; directly learned six-class mixture
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired view, previously explored, pseudo targets only
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random direct mixture network, fixed blind six-component physical posterior and frozen F; DURA loaded only after training for source comparison.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source blind epoch10 and 8192-ID six-class source prior; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; controller new from scratch.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: All 38951 legal source fit IDs excluding 8192 prior IDs, views21/22/23; 8 epochs final checkpoint; fixed blend .25/.5/1 on 384 RX8 source diagnostic IDs; no automatic target test.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single owner, TF32 disabled; mixed L_s/U_s source gradient smoke; preserve other owners

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metric_names: eligible source train exposures and L_s labels
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Weight each source record 5 if fixed parent disagrees with legal L_s truth or high-confidence U_s clean-F pseudo target, otherwise 1; optimize F waveform CE + 0.5 controller CE + 0.2 normalized IQ MSE; no U_s truth, V or test.

rows.method: full-source direct physical mixture with parent-error weighted loss
rows.purpose: increase source coverage and emphasize parent hard examples
rows.seed_notes: All source training IDs excluding 8192 prior IDs; network seed 2026122054, training order seed 2026121856; source evaluation seed 2026120355.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 38951 source fit IDs x 3 fixed views, 8 epochs, 384 RX8 source diagnostic records

notes: Proposed after observing small-source direct mixture and prior concentration; training size and hard weighting change together. Source IDs previously explored in other views. Legal L_s truth and U_s pseudo targets only; DURA comparison after fit; no U_s truth, V or test.
